Ram Temple Trust Chairman Hospitalized in ICU

Mahant Nritya Gopal Das, the 89-year-old chairman of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, has been admitted to an Intensive Care Unit in Lucknow. He was diagnosed with a urinary tract infection and was found unconscious. This hospitalization occurs shortly before a significant trust meeting.
